reading: Arms A, B, C measured on the 28 held units (A, B 2 samples; C 1); arm D not yet measured: its policy server waits behind the memory ledger's queue head (aei1-r0001-build, 24 GB). Quality: the frontier arms are at ceiling (A 55/56, B 56/56); the program on base LFM3 with reasoned decisions is not distinguishable from A at n=28 (C-reasoned 26/28, -5.4 pts, CI [-17.9, +3.6], p 0.56), while instant decisions collapse (C-instant 4/28, -84 pts, p 0.0001: base's instant readout picks the first option, P(urgent)=0.89-0.91 on every ticket). Cost and latency: Luna wins by orders of magnitude on this hardware: A /bin/bash.006 and B /bin/bash.021 per 100 units at list price, p50 2.1 s / 3.2 s; C-reasoned 118 busy GPU-seconds per unit (.28 per 100 at $1/GPU-hour) and p50 103 s, measured on the Python reference engine on a GB10 shared with a 128-slot collection actor (~15 decode tokens/s), dominated by the summary's tool loop (4-5k-token prompts, several turns) and 4 reasoning samples per decision. Nothing was crisp-served (specialization off in B, C). No arm beats A.
